harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Locked curl's version on node1 using dnf versionlock so a system update will not upgrade it, then verified the hold survives a full node restart.
actions_performed: Inspected node1: RHEL 9.8, curl-7.76.1-40.el9.x86_64, dnf/yum present
Applied 'dnf versionlock add curl', creating lock entry curl-0:7.76.1-40.el9.*

Verified 'dnf check-update curl' returns no update and a full 'dnf upgrade --assumeno' dry-run (98 packages, incl. newer curl-7.76.1-40.el9_8.7 available) excludes curl while other packages including libcurl would upgrade
Captured baseline boot_id (bf4e9cbb-...) and uptime before restart
Issued 'systemctl reboot' on node1, acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec was available again; confirmed new boot_id (aca0026b-...) and ~25s uptime, proving an actual restart occurred
Post-restart: verified curl package still at 7.76.1-40.el9, versionlock entry for curl persisted, and check-update/upgrade dry-run again exclude curl from updates

evidence.requirement: Baseline: curl installed version and package manager identified
evidence.summary: node1 is RHEL 9.8 with dnf/yum; curl-7.76.1-40.el9.x86_64 installed

evidence.requirement: versionlock plugin installed and lock applied to curl
evidence.summary: Installed python3-dnf-plugin-versionlock and added versionlock entry curl-0:7.76.1-40.el9.*

evidence.requirement: Proof the hold actually prevents curl from being updated by a system update
evidence.summary: check-update shows no update for curl despite curl-7.76.1-40.el9_8.7 being available in the repo; full 'dnf upgrade --assumeno' dry-run upgrades 98 packages (including libcurl) but excludes curl itself

evidence.requirement: Healthy baseline and boot identity before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id bf4e9cbb-84f9-45f0-9b81-6602b98cea07 and curl package state prior to restart

evidence.requirement: Restart acknowledgement and node unreachable during reboot
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot issued (ack returned before disconnect); subsequent polls timed out while node1 was rebooting

evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proving actual restart occurred
evidence.summary: New boot_id aca0026b-bb74-4a58-9f73-635fe9e72967 (different from baseline) with ~25s uptime confirms a genuine reboot, not just a service restart

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery: version lock and curl package state persisted
evidence.summary: After reboot, curl remains at 7.76.1-40.el9, versionlock entry for curl still present, and a fresh upgrade dry-run again excludes curl from the 98-package update set

attempts.summary: Locked curl's version on node1 using dnf versionlock so a system update will not upgrade it, then verified the hold survives a full node restart.
